title: Urd – NIS2 archive
intro: Original log batches stored before normalization. Every hour has a manifest with SHA-256 sums of its segments, linked to the previous hash (a chain). Verification detects modified, removed or added data.
verifyRequested: Verification requested – the archiver starts it within a minute.
unknownFiles: The last verification found files unknown to the catalog ({{count}}) – an administrator decides whether to adopt or quarantine them.
currentHour: Current hour: {{segments}} segments, {{batches}} batches ({{size}}), last write {{ago}} – the manifest is created after the full hour.

stat.firstManifest: first manifest after a full hour
stat.waiting: {{h}} h waiting for a full check

noManifests: No manifests yet – the first one is created after a full hour of archiver operation.
recoveriesIntro: Reconciliations of the archive catalog with the files on disk: automatic after a database backup is restored (files written between the dump and the restore, after checking sums and the chain) and administrator decisions. Every operation is also saved as a file in the archive directory recoveries/ – it survives another database restore.
howToEnableText: Run the archiver service in the stack (archive directory owned by the Vardr services user) – details in the documentation, docs/en/installation.md and docs/en/operations.md.

manifest.linked: Previous hash: {{hash}}… – matches the previous manifest
manifest.broken: The previous hash does not match the previous row
manifest.expiredTip: Data removed after retention {{date}}; the entry stays in the chain
manifest.verifiedTip: Content fully checked (SHA-256 of every batch) {{date}}
manifest.storedTip: In the archive; the full content check happens in later verification runs (file presence and size are always checked)

verif.fullTip: Manifests whose content was read and fully checked in this run

recovery.requested: Requested: {{kind}} – the archiver performs it within a minute and verifies the archive right away.
recovery.pendingTitle: Request #{{id}} is waiting for the archiver
recovery.pendingText: {{kind}} – {{n}} files, requested by {{by}}. The archiver performs it within a minute and verifies the archive right away.
recovery.unknownTitle: Files unknown to the catalog ({{n}}) – administrator decision
recovery.unknownText: The most common cause: a database backup restore – the catalog went back to the moment of the dump, while files written later stayed on disk. The verification result stays in the history unchanged; the decision is a separate entry (archive catalog, a file in the archive directory, audit log). Nothing is deleted.
recovery.adoptHint: the archiver checks the format and SHA-256 sums of every batch (for a manifest – also the chain continuity); a mismatching file is rejected
recovery.quarantineHint: the file is moved to the quarantine/ directory in the archive – kept, but outside the chain (e.g. unclear origin)
recovery.reasonHint: recorded in the archive catalog and audit log, e.g. “backup restore from 19.10 08:05 – segments written between the dump and the restore”

replay.title: Replay from the archive
replay.intro: Original batches from the selected archive hours go through normalization again – on a separate path, into a separate table. Replayed events are visible in Mímir after switching to “Replayed from archive”; they do not mix with live events and do not go to detection. Useful e.g. for analysing data older than the event database retention. The request is recorded in the audit log.
replay.requested: Replay requested – the archiver starts it within a few seconds.
replay.agentsHint: agent identifiers separated by commas; empty = all
replay.reasonHint: e.g. incident number – recorded in the audit log

export.requested: Export requested – the archiver prepares the package within a few seconds.
export.intro: A package (.tar) to hand over e.g. to an auditor, the CSIRT or a supervisory authority – readable without Vardr: events from the selected hours as NDJSON (ECS fields + original XML) and CSV, and as evidence the original segments, the manifest chain and SHA-256 sums. The recipient runs the included odczytaj.exe (check + readable RAPORT.txt and daily event files) or the Python script narzedzia/odczytaj_segmenty.py. The request and every download are recorded in the audit log.
export.selectionHint: No selection – all sources. The selection limits the readable part (events, the odczytaj.exe report); the evidence (segments) contains all batches from the selected hours, because only a whole segment can be checked against its manifest.
export.reasonHint: e.g. inspection or case number – recorded in the audit log and the package
export.downloadsOff: Package downloads are disabled – siem-api has no access to the exports directory (SIEM_ARCHIVE_EXPORT_DIR).

policy.scheduledMsg: The change weakens archive protection – it takes effect after the grace period; until then it can be cancelled.
policy.appliedMsg: Change requested – the archiver applies it within a minute.
policy.cancelledMsg: Change cancelled – the archiver closes it within a minute.
policy.none: The policy has not been saved yet – the archiver creates it at first start.
policy.target: Target: archiving {{state}}, retention {{days}} days, excluded sources: {{sources}}.
policy.boundsHint: Set in the archiver configuration (SIEM_ARCHIVE_MIN/MAX_RETENTION_DAYS, SIEM_ARCHIVE_POLICY_GRACE, SIEM_ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE_AGENTS) – the panel cannot change them.
policy.changeIntro: Enabling the archive, a longer retention or including more sources takes effect within a minute. Disabling, a shorter retention or excluding sources weaken protection: they require your password again, take effect after the grace period ({{grace}}) and can be cancelled until then. Disabling applies only to new batches – archived data is kept until the end of retention. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
policy.exGroupsLabel: Agent groups excluded from the archive
policy.exGroupsHint: an agent moved to an excluded group (also with an enrolment token) leaves the archive only after the grace period
policy.exAgentsHint: agent identifiers (suggestions from the agent list; Enter adds)
policy.reasonHint: recorded in the audit log and the policy history
policy.weakens: This change weakens protection ({{what}}) – you will be asked for your password after submitting.
policy.tipPending: the archiver processes the request within a minute
policy.confirmText: It takes effect after the grace period ({{grace}}); until then the panel and an alert show it as scheduled and it can be cancelled.
